### Bitbucket

**Categories:** Source control and repository management<br>
**Roles:** DevOps Engineer, Developer Experience Engineer, Release Engineer<br>
**Model:** Unknown<br>

### Codeberg

**Categories:** Source control and repository management<br>
**Roles:** DevOps Engineer, Release Engineer, Developer Experience Engineer<br>
**Model:** Free Saas<br>
**Status:** Active

Non-profit hosted software forge built on Forgejo for free and open-source projects.

**Use when**

- You need a community-governed hosted Git forge for openly licensed projects.

**Consider alternatives when**

- Avoid it when enterprise SLAs, proprietary public projects, or self-hosted administrative control are required.

[Official site](https://codeberg.org/) · [Documentation](https://docs.codeberg.org/)

### Gerrit Code Review

**Categories:** Source control and repository management<br>
**Roles:** DevOps Engineer, Release Engineer, Developer Experience Engineer<br>
**Model:** Oss<br>
**Status:** Active

Self-hosted Git code-review system with change-based workflows and granular access controls.

**Use when**

- You need enforced pre-submit review with Gerrit's change and patch-set workflow.

**Consider alternatives when**

- Avoid it when contributors and automation require a conventional pull-request workflow with lower operating overhead.

[Official site](https://www.gerritcodereview.com/) · [Documentation](https://gerrit-documentation.storage.googleapis.com/Documentation/3.13.0/index.html) · [Source repository](https://gerrit.googlesource.com/gerrit)
